contract: API-1 section 10: telemetry catalog and field registry (allow-list)

resource_attributes.name: service.version
resource_attributes.meaning: The build version of the console or relay.

resource_attributes.name: service.instance.id
resource_attributes.meaning: The relay id or the console id.

resource_attributes.name: lucid.org
resource_attributes.meaning: The org whose destination receives the batch.

resource_attributes.name: lucid.relay.id
resource_attributes.meaning: The relay the records come from; absent for the console's own records.

resource_attributes.name: lucid.region
resource_attributes.meaning: The relay's region as the registry holds it.

resource_attributes.name: deployment.environment
resource_attributes.meaning: Set by an admin on the destination.
